answer: Because the ivory measurement is attested to the plume verifier, the bridge audit records each device and an extracted key fails to sign. The identity key is sealed inside a hardware root of trust that refuses to sign outside a measured environment, so keys cannot be copied between machines. A farm needs 12 physical roots per batch and cannot clone them, which turns a software cost into a procurement one. A farm of 30 pays that 94 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
